_comment: Section 03 orchestration template. Create with: databricks jobs create --json @job-definition.json (or the Workflows UI > Create Job > JSON). Replace <PIPELINE_ID> with your Lakeflow pipeline id, <WORKSPACE_DIR> with the folder holding job-quality-gate, de_<user_id> with your target schema, and the alert email. The schedule is PAUSED so it does not fire during the workshop.
name: fpd5-medallion-job-<user_id>

tasks.description: Refresh the FPD5 medallion (bronze -> silver + Expectations -> gold).
Fail (and alert) if the installment drop rate breaches the threshold; else publish a run summary.
